examples.title: Последние 20 чеков
examples.sql: SELECT TOP (20) * FROM Orders ORDER BY OrderDate DESC;

examples.title: Состав одного чека
sql: SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, p.ProductName, i.Quantity, i.Price, i.DiscountPct,
JOIN OrderItems i ON i.OrderID = o.OrderID
JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = i.ProductID

examples.title: Выручка по магазинам
sql: SELECT s.StoreName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS Checks,
CAST(SUM(i.Quantity * i.Price * (1 - i.DiscountPct / 100)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
JOIN Stores s ON s.StoreID = o.StoreID
JOIN OrderItems i ON i.OrderID = o.OrderID

examples.title: Выручка по месяцам
sql: CAST(SUM(i.Quantity * i.Price * (1 - i.DiscountPct / 100)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
JOIN OrderItems i ON i.OrderID = o.OrderID

examples.title: Дерево категорий
sql: SELECT parent.CategoryName AS TopCategory, c.CategoryName AS SubCategory
JOIN Categories parent ON parent.CategoryID = c.ParentID

examples.title: Заканчивается на складе
sql: JOIN Stores s ON s.StoreID = st.StoreID
JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = st.ProductID

examples.title: Две базы: покупатели — клиенты банка
sql: SELECT c.FullName, c.Phone, b.ClientID AS BankClientID, b.ClientType
JOIN Bank.dbo.Clients b ON b.Phone = c.Phone

examples.title: USE: переключение базы
sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS CurrentDb, COUNT(*) AS Clients FROM Clients;
examples.note: После выполнения песочница переключится на базу Bank — как в SSMS.
